entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Supreme Court of the Republic of Bashkortostan is a regional court for the region of Bashkortostan. It is the court of last resort in Russian administrative law, civil law and criminal law cases. It also supervises the work of lower courts. Its predecessor is the Supreme Court of the Bashkir ASSR.
